title: Russian Drone Strikes SBU Headquarters in Kyiv for First Time in the War, Zelensky Vows Retaliation
detail: A Russian drone struck the central headquarters of Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) on Volodymyrska Street in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district, directly opposite St. Sophia's Cathedral, at around 3:30 p.m. local time on September 4 — the first known direct hit on the SBU's central building since the full-scale invasion began. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the drone was aimed specifically at the office of acting SBU chief Oleksandr Poklad, who was not present at the time. At least 12 people were injured, seven hospitalized. The building's exterior wall was damaged along with windows in nearby historic structures; St. Sophia's Cathedral itself was undamaged. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha called the strike 'a major escalation that demands resolute responses,' saying it showed Moscow's rejection of diplomacy during a renewed push for peace talks. By evening, Zelensky said Ukraine had chosen where it would strike back in retaliation, with only timing left open 'for maximum effect.'

title: Russian Strikes Kill 6, Injure 56 Nationwide Including Fatal Odesa Attack
detail: Beyond the daytime SBU headquarters strike, Russian attacks killed at least six people and injured at least 56 others across Ukraine in the 24 hours to September 4, Ukrainian authorities said. An overnight strike on Odesa killed one person and injured at least three, damaging residential buildings and cars, regional administration head Serhii Lysak said. Other casualties were reported in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (2 police officers killed, 1 hospitalized, 5 civilians injured), Dnipro city (1 killed, 9 injured), Kherson Oblast (1 killed, 8 injured), Zaporizhzhia Oblast (1 killed, 4 injured, with 890 artillery, drone, and air strikes recorded across 49 settlements), Kharkiv Oblast (4 injured), Donetsk Oblast (5 wounded), and Sumy Oblast (2 injured). Russia launched 121 Shahed-type attack drones overnight, about half of them jet-powered variants; Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 103 of the drones and munitions.
